basis: Andrew, 5 Nov 2026 (08:2x AEST): "P39 leaves at 9am". 1327216 is P39's only unit (Coates portable building; ticked Ready 4 Nov; Brenden Meek's booking for 4 Nov 12:30 did not happen; read 08:2x AEST, not already left), so P39 left in full at 09:00 AEST on Thu 5 Nov 2026. Its two air conditioners 1272737 and 1327936 and its fire extinguisher stay listed on P39 as gear that goes with it. Recorded after 09:00, as a departure is only recorded once its time has come.
